# apple_background_asset (Resource)

Creates an Apple-hosted asset pack for an app's background assets. Upload its contents with `apple_background_asset_version`. App Store Connect can't delete an asset pack, so destroying the resource archives it, and creating one with the identifier of an archived asset pack restores that one. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_background_asset" "tutorial" {
  app_id                = data.apple_app.example.id
  asset_pack_identifier = "Tutorial"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app. Changing it creates a new asset pack.
- `asset_pack_identifier` (String) Identifier of the asset pack, which must match the ID in its manifest. Changing it creates a new asset pack.

### Read-Only

- `created_date` (String) When the asset pack was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the asset pack.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_background_asset.tutorial
  identity = {
    id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the asset pack.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_background_asset.tutorial 1234567890
```
